controller_source: Sadat-Hosseini et al. (2015), CFD and Potential Flow Simulations of Fully Appended Free Running 5415M in Irregular Waves, Table 5, case 206 CFD/PF
scope: One published beam-case controller is borrowed for all headings. It is not claimed to be the actual controller of every EFD case.
horizontal_model: Zero-perturbation linear hull response with prescribed wave and roll forcing; no statistical covariance closure
roll_model: Existing Gaussian equivalent roll damping; calibration unchanged
